summaries.title: Hospital Discharge Summary - Cardiology & Diabetes Clinic

lines.text: Patient was admitted for Type 2 Diabetes management and mild hypertension.
Take Tablet Metformin 500mg once daily in the morning after breakfast.
Take Tablet Amlodipine 5mg once daily at night after dinner.
Take Tablet Panadol 500mg as needed for body ache or fever, not exceeding two tablets per day.
Avoid lifting heavy weights above 5 kg for the next two weeks.
Keep salt intake low and avoid oily fried foods.
Walk lightly for 15 to 20 minutes daily in the evening.
Follow-up consultation is scheduled on 26 October 2026 at 10:00 AM in Room 14.
